hero.eyebrow: Handyman & carpentry across the Twin Cities
hero.headline: Handyman jobs and custom carpentry in Minneapolis, done right at a fair price.
hero.subhead: Repairs, drywall, painting, mounting, doors, locks and custom carpentry across Minneapolis, St. Paul and the metro. Send your list and get a clear written estimate.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the AJ's Home & Handyman assistant. Got a list of jobs or a custom project in mind? Tell me about it and I'll help you get an estimate or book a time.

about.headline: Your whole list, handled by one person you can trust.
about.body: Most homeowners have the same problem: a list of jobs that never gets done because nobody wants the small stuff. You want someone who shows up on time, prices it fairly and does it properly, whether it's drywall, a TV on the wall or a custom barn door.

cards.title: The never-ending to-do list
cards.body: Light fixtures, mirrors, cabinets, drywall and paint, ticked off in one visit.

cards.title: Something custom
cards.body: Fireplace mantles, barn doors and one-off builds made to fit your home.

cards.title: Owners who can't be there
cards.body: A quick call and the problem gets handled, with clear updates the whole way.

about.closing: Not sure if it's worth a call? Send the list and we'll let you know.

problems.headline: Getting small jobs done in the Twin Cities shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow estimates
points.body: Nobody calls back for the small jobs, so the list keeps growing.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: No idea what it'll cost until the bill shows up.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Handymen who don't show up on the day they promised.

points.title: Sloppy finishing
points.body: Drywall patches you can see from across the room.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase anyone to get the small stuff done properly.

solutions.headline: Straightforward handyman work with fair pricing.

services.title: Custom carpentry & doors
services.body: Barn doors, fireplace mantles, custom builds and door and lock upgrades.

services.title: Drywall, painting & repairs
services.body: Drywall repair, removal and installation, painting, and repairs around the house.

services.title: Mounting & installs
services.body: TVs, garage storage, light fixtures, medicine cabinets and mirrors, installed properly.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Price it clearly. Get it done.

steps.title: Send your list
steps.body: Send the jobs and a few photos with the form or give AJ a call.

steps.title: Timely, tidy work

steps.body: We go over everything with you and sort anything on the list before we call it done.

why.headline: One call, and the list gets done.

themes.title: Quality work
themes.body: Repairs and custom builds done properly, not patched over.

themes.body: Shows up when promised and keeps you updated.

realReviews.author: Hollie Athen
realReviews.text: Had a list of projects to have completed. AJ custom made a fireplace and mantle, a custom barn door, installed new light fixtures throughout my home, installed new medicine cabinets and mirrors, and repaired drywall.  Highly recommend AJ for home repairs and handyman services.  Prices are very reasonable.

realReviews.author: Jennifer Athen
realReviews.text: AJ's has been extremely helpful! I have had several services performed including TV mounting, hanging garage storage assembly and mounting, oven repair, painting, drywall removal and installation, and they even built a custom cornhole game for my husband. The customer service is amazing and they are always timely with their services.

realReviews.author: Kriss Romano
realReviews.text: Andrew had been an amazing help. We have 2 homes. One in AZ & one in MN. Just a quick call to Andrew and he was able to fix the water issue in MN. He let us know what items were needed, sent us a link to pay for these items, then did the upgrade on door & locks. It is invaluable to have him a phone call away and trust him immensely.  One would be lucky to have him.

finalCta.headline: Got a list that needs doing?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about the job.

faq.a: Send the job or your whole list through the form or give us a call. We'll ask a few questions, come out if needed, and send a written estimate.
The Twin Cities metro, including Minneapolis, St. Paul, Edina, Bloomington, Eden Prairie, Minnetonka, Maple Grove and Brooklyn Park. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.
Yes. A single light fixture or a TV on the wall is fine, and it's even better when you bundle a few jobs together.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set a time.
